notes:
Inbound from indie mobile game studio focused on live social chat inside casual multiplayer. Self-serve signup -> dev key used in staging. Primary ask: sub-200ms p99 for 128-token chat to preserve in-game feel. High sensitivity to per-token cost because chat is monetized via virtual goods; small margins. Interested only in Hosted API for now (want fast time-to-market).

Tech/requirements summary:
- workload: real-time voice/text chat, ephemeral messages, in-chat moderation + auto-mute for flagged content
- latency: target p50 ~100ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 < 200ms for 64-128 token exchanges (they stream tokens to client)
- throughput: bursts during peak match-making windows ~200 concurrent chats per region, avg message length short (20-60 tokens)
- moderation: need pre-response safety filter + post-response logging; prefer webhook for flagged msgs and ability to auto-suppress
- routing: multi-region low-latency (NA primary), no private VPC requirement today
- model preferences: small/efficient convo models; willing to try Redwood-verified open variants; want quant recommendations for cost.

Sales notes / quotes:
- dev lead: "If we can't hit sub-200ms p99 we can't swap out existing websocket chat; players notice lag."
- product: "Cost per monthly active user matters — we can't double token cost."

POC plan: AE sent POC checklist + pricing examples 3/12. SE to run synthetic bench and share sample traces + suggestions (batching/windowing configs). If benchmarks look good, run 2-week trial on hosted API with throttles and moderation hooks.

Next steps: SE bench 3/15-3/17, follow-up call 3/19 to review results. Ask: allow short-term increased rate limits on dev key for realistic bench.
